risks.title: Raw material price fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Risk discussed in the opening section of Item 1A, with direct impact on gross margin. Approximately 28% of nuts and dried fruits purchases sourced internationally. Language emphasizes significant potential cost impact. Dependence on nuts, cocoa, and dried fruits exposes the company substantially to commodity volatility. High weighting for macro risk.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly quantified: a hypothetical 10% increase in rates would impact net income by 0.3 million dollars. No hedging in place on floating-rate debt. Central position in 10-K but moderate impact. Capital category with medium weighting.

risks.title: Foreign exchange costs
risks.score_rationale: Although purchases are in USD, underlying costs vary with USD vs. local currency exchange rates (e.g., euro). Mentioned in context of international purchases (28%). Language cautious but not alarmist. Indirect but real risk to cost competitiveness.

risks.title: SERP pension plan obligations
risks.score_rationale: Projected benefit obligation reaches 28.7 million dollars (Note 15). Discount rate is critical assumption subject to judgment. Subject of Critical Audit Matter, highlighting its importance. Potential high impact on financial statements if assumptions are revised.

risks.title: Dependence on foreign supply sources
risks.score_rationale: 28% of nuts purchases sourced internationally, creating logistical and commercial vulnerability. Indirect risk of disruption or cost increase from geopolitical or climate factors. Mentioned in raw materials pricing context but implies major operational exposure.

risks.title: Cocoa price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Cocoa is significant ingredient for company's snack bar product line. Prices reached records in December 2024 and remain well above historical levels. Three consecutive years of supply deficit created structural price tension. High risk of margin and competitiveness impact if prices do not fall quickly.

risks.title: Tariff impacts on imports
risks.score_rationale: Approximately 2% of material costs (pepitas and pine nuts) subject to 55% tariffs imported from China. Cashews imported from Vietnam (majority) subject to 20% tariffs. Tariff uncertainty complicates planning. Material potential impact if tariffs are maintained or increased.

risks.title: Decline in branded product demand
risks.score_rationale: Sales volume decline for nuts, mixed dried fruits, and bars. Consumers reducing purchases of branded products due to uncertain economic demand and elevated retail pricing. Decline observed both for the company and across the snack food industry. Significant structural risk to revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: JBSS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report.
